critical_corrections: Girish–Servedio extremal Forrelation is an adaptive randomized lower bound (arXiv v1 Theorem 1.4); the packet prior-art note incorrectly calls it nonadaptive.
Canonne–Chen–Mestre arXiv:2602.07503v2, dated 2026-10-01, replaces a gapped v1 proof and proves the near-square-root bound only for nonadaptive algorithms.
Girish arXiv:2510.06385v3 is titled Fourier Spectrum of Noisy Quantum Algorithms; it corrects an important earlier proof issue.
Tal Section 8 explicitly poses the exact-level-k possibility. The packet should credit this motivation while distinguishing its smooth distribution from Tal’s sign-rounded D_{U,k}.
Theorem numbers in malformed packet extractions are unreliable: use pinned PDFs and the bibliography note.
